question: Who hosted the 2011 cricket world cup?
solution:
The correct answer is__** India, Sri Lanka, and Bangladesh.**__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• India & Bangladesh will co-host the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup in October/November 2031.
 
• Earlier, Bangladesh organised 2011 World Cup along with India and Sri Lanka while they successfully arranged 2014 T20 World Cup.
 
• The ICC also confirmed the 14 host countries of the ICC men's white ball events from 2024-2031. 
 
• The USA and Namibia will host an ICC World Cup event for the first time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/292e0c96dd6c006ce1f3ef21b86308c7c73a2bc69f508d641b46f352d114f429.png] Important Points__

__
 
• ​India & Sri Lanka will co-host the ICC Men's T20 World Cup in February 2026.
 
• India will also host the 2029 Champions Trophy singularly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• About ICC Men's Cricket World Cup:

 
 
• The Cricket World Cup (officially known as ICC Men's Cricket World Cup) is the international championship of One Day International (ODI) cricket.
 
• The event is organised by the sport's governing body, the International Cricket Council (ICC), every four years, with preliminary qualification rounds leading up to a finals tournament.
 
• The first World Cup was organised in England in June 1975, with the first ODI cricket match having been played only four years earlier.
 
 
 
• Facts about List of ICC ODI Cricket World Cup Winners:
 
 
• First Edition: 1975.
 
• First Winner: West Indies.
 
• Current champion: Australia, 2023 World Cup edition, held in India.
 
• Most successful Team: Australia (5 titles).
 
• India & West Indies are the only two countries which have won the world cup 2 times each.
 
• India won the World Cup in 1983 and 2011, while West Indies won in 1975 and 1979.
